title: Patch release hooks the wallet constructor and posts the private key it is given
intent: Models the wallet-drainer shape: a patch hooks the Wallet constructor of an SDK and ships the caller's privateKey argument in an https.request body. The key comes from a constructor parameter, not the environment or a credential file, so only the key-material flow rule can see it; it must fire high on the request handle's end() call in a modified module. Safe: host is example.invalid and no key value exists.
